title: Gossip honours bind_address
goal: Every daemon listener honours the configured bind_address. Gossip (UDP 9095 plus offset) bound the wildcard in every privacy mode, so a daemon configured with bind_address 127.0.0.1 still listened for gossip on every interface. Gossip now binds bind_address at its port, falls back to an ephemeral port on that same address (never the wildcard), and host_only still narrows a wider address to loopback. The A2A UDP discovery responder and the four host-contract TCP listeners already bind bind_address (verified on a live daemon).
acceptance: cargo test -p susi-daemon --lib gossip_binds_the_configured_bind_address_and_never_the_wildcard --offline --locked passes: with bind_address 127.0.0.1 and host_only off, the real gossip socket's bound address is 127.0.0.1 at the requested port, a datagram to this host's routed address on that port reaches nothing, a taken port falls back to an ephemeral loopback port, and a wildcard bind_address is honoured as configured.
